## ci: synthesize Allie GitHub Release notes with Landmark — pass (head 5da33fa1)

I chose allie#83 because the org-wide Landmark release-note pattern is the only open supply-chain surface in the pool: the sibling habitat#344 copy is blocked on an unpinned `misty-step/landmark@v0` tag, and this head is the flagship implementation — it pins the action, runs synthesis in a job separate from signing, and extends the release-workflow contract smoke to keep the pin and least-privilege shape enforced. The machine merge candidates are not actionable right now (time-tracker#153's base `main` advanced past its head; time-tracker#155's check-runs fail; habitat#343 is superseded on its feature branch), and the rest of the pool is one-line README copies of the same docs change.

What I verified at head `5da33fa15d8684d39e760438e53289e4592f1b41`:

- **The #344 block is addressed here.** `misty-step/landmark@a5869d7bc7a89febb47e2f73f49bdd8a75fa9309` (line 155) is a full 40-char SHA; I confirmed the commit exists upstream (`feat(release-transaction): complete ADR-0004 publish-to-receipt (#253)`, 2026-08-25). The smoke now rejects any non-full-SHA `uses` in the landmark job and any `id-token` on it.
- **Least-privilege shape**: the job's permissions are exactly `contents/issues/pull-requests: write` with no OIDC minting; checkout is `persist-credentials: false` with `fetch-depth: 0`; the job runs only after `sign-and-publish`, whose tag-to-commit binding and exact-asset readback already gate the release, so `release-tag: ${{ github.ref_name }}` refers to a verified tag.
- **Enforcement is wired in**: `scripts/release-workflow-contract-smoke.mjs` runs from `scripts/verify.sh` → CI `verify` job, which is green at this head (`verify` and `supply-chain-audit` both success).
- `.landmark.yml` is complete and consistent with the workflow's `mode: synthesis-only` / `changelog-source: auto`.

## P2 — landmark job has no timeout while a billing-key secret is in scope

- path: .github/workflows/release.yml
- line: 143

Evidence:

```yaml
  landmark:
    needs: sign-and-publish
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      issues: write
      pull-requests: write
```

Body: the `landmark` job hands `llm-api-key: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}` to the third-party action (line 162) with no `timeout-minutes`, so a hung synthesis (LLM stall, retry loop) can bill the OpenRouter key for up to GitHub's default multi-hour job limit. The sibling copies of this same pattern (olympus#635, time-tracker#156, agent-usage-telemetry#50) all set `timeout-minutes: 15`; add the same cap here, and consider making the contract smoke require it.

Human-authored PR (moomooskycow/phaedrus): reviewed, not merged.

— Argus (Olympus)
